scope: Synthetic deterministic summary fidelity held-outs; no external model or service calls.
methodology: Authored and hand-checked independently before production changes. Expected quantities and source relationships derive from synthetic documents.
Fifteen tests use real indexing, retrieval, fact validation and description composition. One directly checks composition when a proposed party role is explicitly unsupported.

Tests cover physical units, numeric ranges, multiword units, Unicode decimal numerals, both fallback and shortening boundaries, incomplete measurement sources, explicit recipient controls, and unsupported secondary directions.
A mentioned quantity must remain complete. Omission of a whole optional quantity or subject is allowed. No invented unit is allowed when the source omits it.

Explicit source sender/recipient controls must preserve direction. Co-issuers, co-senders, observers and referenced parties cannot acquire unsupported directed roles. Neutral wording is accepted when routing is unproved.
Every test checks the 42-word maximum. Tests avoid requiring identical stylistic full sentences.

Baseline and candidate binaries used identical immutable tests, one test thread, and no external services. Gold answers and per-case outcomes stayed outside the implementation loop until candidate freeze; first candidate run passed all sixteen.

platform.execution: Native Rust test binaries on Linux; single test thread; no VM or GPU.

limitations: These 16 deliberately targeted synthetic tests are regression controls, not a statistical estimate of accuracy on real documents or a model benchmark.
Long numeric subjects may be omitted entirely to satisfy the word budget; passing establishes absence of partial quantities rather than guaranteed retention of every fact.
Only the supplied already-compiled binaries were executed by the independent evaluator. Build provenance and broader test coverage belong to the parent run evidence.

final_refinement_regression_recheck.classification: Regression recheck after v1 unseen gate; not an additional unseen evaluation.
final_refinement_regression_recheck.reason: Public-corpus refinement retains a sole otherwise unclassified party with neutral also-naming wording instead of directional inference.
limitations: The held-out suite was released after the successful v1 gate. This later run is a regression recheck and provides no new unseen-test claim.
The synthetic regression scope and permitted omission of whole optional numeric subjects remain unchanged.
No compilation, model call or private user-document access was performed by the independent evaluator for this recheck.
